page_title: CEL 1-1 SEV | Celta Vigo v Sevilla 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: de la Torre L. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Celta Vigo! Play can continue.

90+8' There's a break in play and referee Alejandro Hernandez must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Celta Vigo using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+2' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' It's like he was asking for a caution. Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) receives a yellow card.
84' 1 - 1 Goal! Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:1.
82' Rafael Benitez prepares a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen is replaced by Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo).
81' Jonathan Bamba comes off the pitch to be replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
80' This is a yellow card! Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
79' A corner kick by Sevilla is thwarted by the well prepared Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo).
75' Sevilla take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
70' Here comes a substitution. Oliver Torres is given a rest as he is replaced by Suso (Sevilla).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch for Mariano Diaz.
69' Rafael Benitez decides to make a substitution. Iago Aspas will be replaced by Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo).
69' Today's match ends for Hugo Sotelo who will be replaced by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo).
65' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
65' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) gets a yellow card.
64' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
63' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) is coming onto the pitch as Kevin Vazquez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
57' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.

54' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the top right corner. Vicente Guaita displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
54' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
50' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) but poses no threat.
49' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
47' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
47' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Celta Vigo.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) comes off for Dodi Lukebakio.
46' Diego Alonso has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) comes on the pitch for Marcos Acuna.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+1' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
45' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

43' Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.

34' Loic Bade (Sevilla) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball has crossed the sideline. Sevilla are taking a throw-in.
29' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
28' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
24' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

24' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Vicente Guaita is prepared and leaps to thwart him. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.

22' 1 - 0 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) who finds himself some space and scores with a thunderous header into the bottom right corner. An incredible long-range header!
20' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Hernandez signals a foul.
18' A short pass finds Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
16' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
15' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
13' The opposition can't get near Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just over the bar at the last second.
10' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
9' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) brings his opponent down. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Sevilla have a free kick from a promising distance.
6' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Celta Vigo have a corner.
4' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) sends a long ball in, but Vicente Guaita comfortably gathers the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
Show lineups
